summary_text: The user demonstrates a strong, stable preference for Pampers diapers, specifically the Complete Skin Comfort Pant Diapers in XL size (56 count). This preference is supported by consistent ordering across six months (January–June 2026), with high-confidence evidence in February and June, and medium-to-high confidence in other months. While early months showed variation in size (L/XL) and daypart, recent behavior (May–June) stabilizes on XL size and afternoon/weekday timing. No other brands or significant product variants have been observed.
